integrity: Analytical proof covers all parameters; exhaustive finite diagnostics are only supporting checks. No independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: The factor is a scalar cyclic phase observable, not a factor onto the full spatial clock automaton.
The rule is a translation plus a uniform group increment, not a general affine cellular automaton.
Full-coordinate-support minimality is established only when the ring length is coprime to the shift-clock product.
Priority against unindexed older equivalent orbit computations is not fully excluded.
title: Finite-volume clock-factor aliasing in traveling affine cellular automata
